scripts-descriptions.test:all: Unit and integration tests in order (stops at the first failing suite; the integration suite needs Docker Desktop). The E2E suite is long and is run separately with test:e2e
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Unit tests, no WordPress: PHPUnit, then the JavaScript tests with node --test (needs Node on the PATH)
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration tests in Docker (wp-env test environment, port 8893; needs Docker Desktop). Extra PHPUnit options after --
scripts-descriptions.env:tests:start: Start the wp-env test environment of the integration suite
scripts-descriptions.env:tests:stop: Stop the wp-env test environment of the integration suite
scripts-descriptions.env:tests:destroy: Remove the wp-env test environment of the integration suite (containers and database)
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Functional tests (Playwright on the E2E site; needs DLI_E2E_SITE_PATH). Extra options after --
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:headed: Functional tests with a visible browser
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:ui: Functional tests in Playwright UI mode
